sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 9:3

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 9:3:1
items.html:
After the first time, there is never one who raises MAN except the sons, etc., and every lower one is called a son to it: For the matter of raising MAN [Mayin Nukvin] from the lower to the upper is practiced in all the Partzufim of AK and ABYA, and it is a perpetual matter, as written further along. And the content of the matter is that these MAN include all the discernments that came out in the world of Nekudim and were nullified, and also fell to the BYA of separation at the time of the breaking of the vessels, which are the posterior of the three first Partzufim: Keter, and AVI, and YESHSUT, with the ZAT of each and every one of these GAR [first three], as written in Part 7. Also you know that all the forces and flaws that exist in the upper ones must necessarily be found in their lower one. Accordingly, it turns out that in addition to the known rule that the lower one is regarded as half of the upper Partzuf, because of the AHP of the upper that came out outside of the upper, due to the bottom Hey that joined in his Nikvey Einayim and fell to the discernment of a lower degree — for example, the posterior of the point of Keter of Nekudim, which are AHP, fell and were clothed in the internality of AVI, and the posterior of AVI fell and were clothed in the internality of YESHSUT, and so on in the same manner — here it is further regarded that the posterior of all the nine first Sefirot together are found in their Malchut, and likewise the posterior of all the upper Partzufim together are found in their lower one (as the ARI wrote above, page 227, item 6). Thus, the vessels that fell to the final point of all the degrees, namely to the Malchut of BYA, include within themselves all kinds of posterior that were nullified and broken from all the Partzufim of Nekudim at the time of the breaking of the vessels, and they are clothed there one within the other.
And two rules come out for us from this in the matter of MAN. The first is that the posterior of every upper one are found only in its own lower one; and the reason for this is the beginning of the Azilut of the Partzufim of Nekudim, namely from the time of their Katnut, when every degree was breached and divided into two halves, because of the rising of the bottom Hey into the Einayim; and nothing remained in the Guf [body] of the degree but GE, and the AHP descended and became the internality of the degree below it. For example, the AHP of the degree of the Rosh came out from there and became the internality of HGT; hence the Partzuf of HGT is considered the lower half of the Partzuf of the Rosh, because in its domain are found the posterior of the Rosh, namely its AHP. And although at the time of the Gadlut of the Partzufim of Nekudim all the halves of the degrees returned from within the lower one and joined again in their place in the upper, as known — namely, by the illumination of the coupling of AB-SAG, which breaches and nullifies the boundary of the second restriction in the Parsa, and therefore the bottom Hey returns and descends from the Einayim to the Peh as at first, as known — however, owing to the breaking of the vessels, the light of the coupling of AB-SAG returned and was nullified, and the second restriction of the bottom Hey in the Einayim returned to its place, and all the halves of the upper degrees fell again to their lower ones, as they were at the beginning of their Azilut, for all the AHP of the upper came and fell into the internality of the lower, as above. And here the first rule in the MAN is explained: the posterior of every upper one are found only in the lower degree adjacent to it; and for this reason every lower one is considered half of the upper.
And the second rule is that every lower one carries within itself all the kinds of posterior that fell from all the Partzufim that are from it and above. For example, in the Nukva of Nekudim, which is the Malchut of that name, are found all the AHP that were nullified and fell from all the upper ones: from Keter, from AVI, and from YESHSUT, etc. And likewise, in the Malchuts of BYA are found all the posterior of the nine upper Sefirot that are there. And this is for the known reason that all the forces and diminutions that exist in the upper ones must be in their lower one.
For since the upper is the cause of the existence of the lower, all the diminutions and flaws that are in its upper act upon it, for it becomes the consequence and is affected by them — understand this very well.
And with the above two rules you will understand that there is no possibility whatsoever for the completion of the ten Sefirot in the upper Partzuf except with the help of the lower one raising MAN to it, for the lower one holds the AHP of the upper in its domain, and the upper has nothing but GE alone. Although the AHP are its posterior vessels, namely Bina and ZON, or NHY, still, when the NHY of the vessels are missing from the Partzuf, they cause it to be deficient in the GAR of the lights, as known. And you see that as long as the lower one does not rise as MAN to the upper, the upper must remain in its Katnut without GAR.
And this is what he said, “always there is no one who raises MAN after the first time except the sons who have already come out into the world and were corrected, and every lower one is called a son to the one above it” — meaning, as explained, that the lower one is the one that holds within it the AHP of its upper, and these AHP are called by the name MAN because they were nullified and fell from the upper degree at the time of the breaking of the vessels, as above. Hence there is no one who raises them back to the upper except its son, namely the lower one that holds them in its domain. And the order of the risings of MAN will be explained further along.
And with the second rule you will understand what was said above, that the matter of raising MAN from the lower to the upper is a perpetual thing: for as long as all the vessels and sparks that fell to BYA have not been completed in their clarification, the upper Partzufim of Atzilut are also deficient in exactly that measure, according to the vessels and sparks that are in BYA. For the final discernment in BYA carries within it all the kinds of posterior that are above it; and you already know that these posterior are literally the parts of the vessels and the Sefirot that are missing from the upper Partzufim; and all the fixed Mochin that were corrected in the three first Partzufim of Atzilut are, relative to what they were before in the world of Nekudim, only the discernment of the ten Sefirot of Keter in each of them, so that they are all still lacking the nine lower Sefirot in them. And these are the ones that are placed and held captive in BYA among the shells, as written above (page 685, the passage beginning “in a manner”), study it there well. And it follows, therefore, that at the time when a certain measure of the vessels and sparks of BYA is clarified to Atzilut — namely, to the first degree, which is the Nukva of Atzilut — and you already know that the Nukva of Atzilut is the one that carries within it all the posterior of the upper Partzufim, as above, the Nukva therefore takes from them the discernment of the posterior of her portion, namely that which completes the discernment of ZON; and the rest they raise to AVI, and AVI clarify from them that which belongs to their completion; and the rest they raise to AA, and AA clarifies from it that which belongs to his completion; and the rest to Atik, and so on up to the inner AK. And then the light of Ein Sof descends upon the MAN that are in the inner AK, and new Mochin are made for him from these MAN and MAD [male waters], for the upper light that descends to correct the MAN is called by the name Mayin Duchrin [male waters]; and with the joining of the two, a part of the Mochin is completed for him, namely according to the measure of MAN that his lower one raised to him, which are the parts of the vessels that are missing to him, as above. And then MAD descends from the inner AK through all the Partzufim of AK and Atzilut, and each one is completed according to the measure of MAN that its lower one raised to it, as this is written at length further along.
And here, the beginning of the rising of the MAN — namely, the extraction from within the shells of BYA and their raising to the Nukva of Atzilut — is done by means of the NRN [Nefesh, Ruach, Neshama] of the righteous, into whose domain the discernments of the posterior of ZON fell; for the soul of the first man, Adam HaRishon, is an offspring of the ZON of Atzilut and of the lower degree adjacent to them, as above (Part 8, item 76), and it includes all the souls of the six thousand years, all of which are particular organs that fell off from his soul, as the words of the ARI above (Part 8, item 88). And therefore the posterior that fell outside of the degree of ZON came and were included in the NRN of the righteous in all the generations of the six thousand years. And it follows that there is no one who raises MAN to ZON except their lower one, which holds in its domain the AHP that are missing to ZON, as above; and NRN are the lights of Bina and ZON, for the light of Bina is called Neshama, the light of ZA is called Ruach, and the light of the Nukva is called Nefesh, as known. And accordingly, the Nefesh of the righteous is attributed to the world of Assiya, the Ruach to the world of Yetzira, and the Neshama to the world of Beria. And this is what he said, that the NRN of the righteous are the sons of ZON, and they are the ones who raise the MAN from within the shells in BYA to the ZON of Atzilut — as explained, every lower one holds in its domain all the posterior that are missing to the upper, and hence no completion whatsoever is possible for the upper except with the help of the lower one raising the MAN to it. And with these words are explained all the words of the ARI before us in items 2, 3, 4. And remember them for the entire continuation.
